## How I tested it

- [ ] Added or updated tests (bug fixes include a test that fails without the fix)

## Checklist

- [ ] No data leaves the device without an explicit, opt-in action
- [ ] Errors in user-facing paths are reported, not swallowed
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
